entries.title: MotoGP 26 Gresini Racing Brazil Special Livery
entries.author: CilokMayo57
entries.description: Recreates the special livery Gresini Racing ran at the Brazil round, applied to the bike and rider suit only. Helmets, gloves and boots are not included.

entries.title: MotoGP 26 Sponsors Mod
entries.author: ColangeloDesigns
entries.description: Adds real-world brands and sponsors to the in-game editor so they can be used on helmets and rider stickers. Installed by extracting the files into the game's Paks folder.
